9. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of liberty unlawfully.

Violence against women is any act based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life.
11. Violence against children is any act that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, sexually, economically, socially and psychologically.
12. Acts of violence are women and children who experience misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
13. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecution, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear of or have occurred violence against women.
14. Cooperation is an activity or effort carried out by several people to achieve common goals. 17. Forum for the Protection of Women and Children from Acts of Violence hereinafter abbreviated as FP2ATK is a forum established based on this Regional Regulation whose membership comes from relevant agencies and communities concerned with the empowerment of women and protection of children from acts of violence.
18. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred. 19. Companion is a social worker who has professional competence in their field. 20. Victim recovery is all efforts to strengthen victims of domestic violence to be more empowered, both physically and psychologically. 21. Integrated Service Center for Women and Child Empowerment hereinafter abbreviated as P2TPA is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as Integrated Service Center for Women and Child Empowerment, Safe House, Child Social Protection House, Trauma Center Protection House, Women's Social Protection House, Shelter, or integrated service provider institutions for victims established by the Regional Government.

heading: CHAPTER II
Article 3
CHAPTER III
translated_text:
CHAPTER III

SCOPE

Article 4

1. The Scope of this Regional Regulation consists of a. protection of women; and b. protection of children.
2. Protection of women as referred to in Article 4 letter a includes: a. prevention of acts of violence;
b. integrated services for victims of acts of violence; and c. empowerment of victims of acts of violence. (3) Protection of children as referred to in Article 4 letter b includes: a. protection of children who are victims of acts of violence; and b. special protection of children.

COMMUNITY AND BUSINESS PARTICIPATION

Article 23

(I) Every person may participate in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence; (2) Participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out by: a. reporting acts of violence against women and/or children; b. providing first aid to victims of Acts of Violence; C. independently socializing the rights of women and children; and/or d. establishing independent community social institutions.

Article 26

heading: CHAPTER IX

CHAPTER IX

Article 27

1. The Regional Government implements guidance and supervision of FP2ATK and other social institutions. (2) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out by the Regional Apparatus Organization that implements women and child empowerment affairs. (3) The results of the implementation of guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (2) must be reported to the regional government.

heading: ELUCIDATION OF
translated_text:
ELUCIDATION OF

REGIONAL REGULATION OF NORTH LAMPUNG REGENCY NUMBER 1 OF 2017

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

L GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in North Lampung Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection to women and children victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation to regulate protective measures so that institutional and regulatory support is needed that can guarantee its implementation, especially in terms of prevention, services and empowerment of women and children victims of violence in Lampung Regency

heading: Article 5
translated_text:
Article 5

Sufficiently clear Letter a.

What is meant by "physical violence" is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, unconsciousness and or causes death. Letter b.

What is meant by "sexual violence" is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced sexual intercourse in an unnatural or unwanted manner, forced sexual intercourse with others for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Letter c.

What is meant by "economic violence" is an act that restricts a person from working inside or outside the home to earn money and goods, including allowing a person who works to be exploited, while someone does not fulfill the economic needs of the family.

Letter d.

What is meant by "social violence" is an act of a person or group of people that causes injury or loss of life to a person or can cause physical damage or damage to another person's property Letter e.

What is meant by "psychological violence" is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person.

Letter f.

What is meant by "Domestic Neglect" is:

1. actions that result in the unfulfillment of a child's needs properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social;
2. actions of deliberately neglecting to maintain, care for, or take care of a child as appropriate; 3. actions that neglect a person within the scope of their household, whereas according to the law applicable to them or because of an agreement or contract they are obliged to provide livelihood, care, or maintenance to that person; 4. actions that result in economic dependence by restricting and/or prohibiting proper work inside or outside the home so that the victim is under the control of that person.

Letter g.

What is meant by "neglect of workers" is the action of any person or legal entity that results in improper treatment of female workers whereas according to the law applicable to them or because of an agreement or contract they are obliged to provide adequate protection from lawful actions against workers such as haphazard recruitment, unclear shelters and workplaces, arbitrary business owners.

Letter h.

What is meant by "coercion or deprivation" of freedom is:

1. Coercion is any act or action of taking, bringing, inviting a child or woman with persuasion and or coercion to be made a wife or to be employed illegally.
2. Deprivation of freedom is any act or action of taking, bringing, inviting, kidnapping a child or woman to be made a wife or employed by confining, detaining or imprisoning illegally in a room or certain place.

Letter i.

What is meant by "threat of certain actions" is any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, images, symbols or body movements, either with or without using means

What is meant by "complaint services" is a series of actions carried out by integrated service providers to follow up on reports of acts of violence against women and children submitted by victims, families or the community Letter b. What is meant by "health services" is efforts that include promotive, preventive, curative and rehabilitative aspects. Letter c.

What is meant by "counseling" is a process of providing objective and complete information, conducted systematically with interpersonal communication guidance, guidance techniques and mastery of clinical knowledge aimed at helping a person recognize their current condition, the problems being faced, and determine solutions or efforts to overcome those problems Letter d. What is meant by "spiritual guidance" is a form of activity in which there is a process of spiritual guidance and development for humans so that it can provide peace, tranquility and coolness of heart to humans by always providing encouragement and motivation to remain patient, trust in God and continue to carry out their obligations.

Letter e.

What is meant by "social rehabilitation services" is services aimed at restoring and developing the abilities of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly. Letter f.

What is meant by "legal aid and assistance services" is legal services provided by legal assistants or advocates to conduct the process of accompanying witnesses and/or victims of violence against women and children that is gender sensitive.
